trailing_stop_rule.rule: stop = max(existing stop, daily close - 3 x ATR14); never lowered; acted on ONLY when the improvement exceeds 1 x ATR14
trailing_stop_rule.why: stops were being re-derived from scratch every session, which was the real source of plan drift; this makes 'leave it alone' a computed output rather than a daily judgement call

reporting_rule.rule: The book is reported in two sections that are NEVER summed: CONFIRMED (fill.state == 'confirmed') and ADVISED-UNCONFIRMED. No dollar or percentage P&L may be attached to any line whose fill.state is not 'confirmed'.
reporting_rule.why: 67 log entries over 36 days contained zero confirmed fills, yet BTC and LINK P&L was being reported daily as if the positions existed - about $17 of a claimed ~$180 book.

instruction_format.rule: Every instruction is expressed as a TARGET END STATE ('hold 0.0091 ETH'), never as a delta ('sell 0.0273 ETH'). End states are idempotent: safe to act on whether or not a previous instruction was executed.
instruction_format.why: Repeating a delta into an unknown fill state risks double execution - repeating 'sell 0.0273' to a user who had already sold would have left 0.0023 ETH.
